summary: Added 8 tests pinning the --cell seam. era-cell test: a derived assertion over DESCRIBED_CELLS x ANGULAR_TARGET_CELLS (published resolves to the adapter object; unpublished refuses with plan.angular.declared-cell-not-published), the reverse direction, the never-published id (exit-2 semantics, message names declared + published ids), and default-cell resolver object identity. Flows test: derived per-id plan refusal emitting no plan at all, the end-to-end trap at run level (era-cell green via declared --node, run halts at plan, apply/install/build/witness not-run), the era-cell-owned undescribed half, and command-level explicit-16 identity. Tests/trust/freeze all pass; lint and fmt clean.
open_questions: The TESTS-ONLY verify command cannot match on macOS: BSD `wc -l` pads its output, so `grep -qx '0'` fails even though the filtered diff is empty. Suggest `| tr -d ' '` before the grep.
